state: PREPARED_FOR_ROOT_REVIEW; not applied; product not started

firewall.scope: Temporary owned guest only. Exact custom chains and jump rules; no Windows rules, global policy changes, global flush or persisted configuration.
firewall.input_from_mb28int: Allow only application_ip to gateway TCP 15483/16379; reject every other packet from this bridge.
firewall.forward_from_or_to_mb28int: Reject all in DOCKER-USER before Docker forwarding rules.
firewall.guest_ipv4_output: Allow loopback, ESTABLISHED/RELATED and output to mb28int; reject all other new output during the exclusive runtime window.
firewall.guest_ipv6_output: Allow loopback and ESTABLISHED/RELATED; reject all other new output.
firewall.precondition: No pre-existing external established connection except owned SSH, no other running container/writer, no name/subnet/port/chain collision.
firewall.rollback: Remove only recorded exact jumps/chains, proxies, SSH forwarding PID, owned container/network and own UUID database/roles after attribution checks. Preserve artifacts and other databases.

container_lab_flags.qa_artifact_mount: Only the exact nonsecret owned launcher/attestation directory, read-only; no broad host or guest root share.
container_lab_flags.scope: These are explicit LAB restrictions, not Dockerfile defaults.

credentials.transport: Private 0600 input consumed through child stdin; never CLI, stdout, Docker Config.Env or evidence.
credentials.bootstrap: Container starts a small stdin bootstrap, sets environment only in-process, then execs the unchanged /app/entrypoint.sh.
credentials.database: New attributable UUID database plus separate UUID migrator owner and non-owner application role; no reused unattributed database.
credentials.production_settings: Keep METODOBASE_ENV=production and unmodified Settings/validators. Use QA-only non-provider-authentic synthetic values accepted structurally by those validators; disclose this limit. Do not load real provider secrets or claim provider validity.
credentials.logs: Capture raw logs privately 0600, replace every consumed secret before publishing, inspect only selected non-env Docker fields.
